description: List Delta Meetings for the authenticated organization, newest first, as summary rows: id, title, when, type, status, team, and whether a transcript and a summary exist. Filter by meeting_type or status; with neither, every type is returned. To find the NEXT meeting, pass upcoming=true: only meetings scheduled from now on, soonest first (newest-first plus a limit would otherwise show the furthest-out recurring instances and miss this week's). This tool deliberately does NOT return transcripts or notes -- call get_meeting_transcript or get_meeting_agenda with an id from here for the contents of one meeting.

limit.description: How many meetings to return. Defaults to 25.

upcoming.description: Only meetings scheduled from now on, soonest first. Use this to find the next meeting.

name: list_meetings
